text:
maria: Quick sync — ran the head-to-head load runs comparing replay-harness vs synthetic-proxy for r50/kv-heavy traces. Posting raw notes and a few outliers.

drew: nice. what's the overall p50/p95 delta?

maria: p50 ~ identical (~14ms), p95 replay 3.6x higher than synthetic. suspect KV warmup + kernel fallback noise. logs attached: bench-bot uploaded artifacts. :eyes:

bench-bot: Uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-benches/1819004321/ (profiles, flamegraphs, trace.json)

ashley: Did you run with the new kernel-selector heuristics? (`--kernel-policy=adaptive-v2`)

maria: yes. adaptive-v2 reduced avg kernel-switches but on kv-hot sequences it triggers fallback to fp16 kernels causing ~30% slowdowns in stepwise latency. quick run flags: 
```
--kernel-policy=adaptive-v2
--kv-warmup=1500
--batching=continuous
--speculative=off
```

kevin: could the quant profile be mis-indexed? we saw similar when q4_0 -> q4_1 fallback happened last week.

maria: we pinned q4_1 for this run. speculation: during near-dense KV hits, padding and stride heuristics push selector to choose non-quantized codepath.

sophia: propose a small experiment: hold kernel fixed (no selector) but simulate batching heuristics and kv prefix caching on/off. isolates selector vs cache behavior. :thumbsup:

drew: agree. also add a probe run with synthetic traffic but replayed KV hit map to match warmup distribution (so synthetic isn't too 'cold').

maria: scheduled two isolation runs: 1819004600 (fixed-kernel, selector disabled), 1819004700 (selector+cache-disabled). I'll post diffs when they finish.

bench-bot: run 1819004600 (fixed-kernel) completed. artifacts: s3://redwood-benches/1819004600/summary.json

kevin: first pass — fixed-kernel reduces p95 variance by ~40% on kv-hot traces. downside: avg token throughput drops ~5% (likely fewer kernel-level optimizations).

ashley: that's a plausible tradeoff. we should consider a regression-gate to flip to fixed-kernel when tail crosses threshold.

sophia: agree — implement gate that monitors rolling 1m p95 and toggles policy. add hysteresis and 2m cooldown to avoid flapping.

maria: action items:
- sophia: prototype gate + cooldown (EOD).
- drew: create replay proxy that preserves KV access patterns for synthetic runs (tomorrow).
- kevin: sanity-check quant-index mapping for q4_1 (today).
- ashley: draft perf regression alert thresholds for canary vs prod.

drew: ping me for the harness config; I'll drop the json into the bench bucket.

maria: thanks team. tl;dr: kernel selector improves avg latency but KV warmups and stride heuristics create tail regressions. next step: isolate selector behavior with fixed-kernel runs and add a regression gate for production fallback. :white_check_mark:
